name: chat-request-card
title: Chat Request Card
description: An agent asking a person's OK, drawn from the server's stored offer: ChatRequestCard (Allow once, Always allow ▾ with its scopes, Decline with a note), RequestBundleCard for several asks at once, and RequestLine for a settled ask.

meta.whenToUse: A permission request waiting in an agent chat (ChatRequestCard), Subagents asking together (RequestBundleCard), an answered or refused ask in the turn's log (RequestLine).
meta.whenNotToUse: A list of saved permissions in settings; a general confirmation dialog (AlertDialog).
